title.ar: الدوال والقيمة المطلقة ونظرية المعادلات التربيعية

body.en: Mastering the structural foundations of higher algebra: function domains, codomains, one-to-one conditions for invertibility, modulus equations \( |f(x)| = g(x) \), and precise quadratic discriminant criteria.

A function \( f \) has an inverse \( f^{-1} \) if and only if \( f \) is a one-to-one (injective) mapping across its given domain. For any \( y = f(x) \), \( f^{-1}(y) = x \). The domain of \( f^{-1} \) equals the range of \( f \), and the range of \( f^{-1} \) equals the domain of \( f \). Graphically, \( y = f^{-1}(x) \) is the reflection of \( y = f(x) \) in the line \( y = x \).

label.en: ● Deep Conceptual Intuition — Functions, Modulus & Quadratic Theory
label.ar: ● الفهم المفاهيمي العميق — الدوال والقيمة المطلقة ونظرية المعادلات التربيعية

body.en: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental function \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical equations, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the solution set, requiring a final domain check against the original equation.
body.ar: قيود المجال والدالة العكسية: تمتلك الدالة \(f\) معكوساً \(f^{-1}\) إذا وفقط إذا كانت متباينة (واحد لواحد)، ويكون مجال \(f^{-1}\) هو مدى \(f\) تماماً.

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the range to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).
body.ar: برهان إكمال المربع وتحديد المدى: بكتابة \(ax^2+bx+c = a(x+\frac{b}{2a})^2 + (c-\frac{b^2}{4a})\) وبما أن المربع الكامل غير سالب دائماً، يتحدد رأس القطع ومدى الدالة بدقة.

body.en:
Solve the equation \( |2x - 5| = 3x + 1 \).

Method 1 (Case Analysis):
Case 1: \( 2x - 5 = 3x + 1 \implies -x = 6 \implies x = -6 \).
Check validity: \( |-12 - 5| = 17 \), but \( 3(-6) + 1 = -17 \ne 17 \). Hence \( x = -6 \) is an extraneous solution because the RHS must be non-negative (\( 3x + 1 \ge 0 \implies x \ge -\frac{1}{3} \)).
Case 2: \( -(2x - 5) = 3x + 1 \implies -2x + 5 = 3x + 1 \implies 5x = 4 \implies x = \frac{4}{5} \).
Check: \( |2(0.8) - 5| = |-3.4| = 3.4 \); \( 3(0.8) + 1 = 3.4 \). Valid!

Final Answer: \( x = \frac{4}{5} \).

Find the values of \( k \) for which the line \( y = kx - 2 \) is a tangent to the curve \( y = x^2 + 2x + 7 \).

Solution:
Equate equations: \( x^2 + 2x + 7 = kx - 2 \implies x^2 + (2 - k)x + 9 = 0 \).
Since the line is a tangent, the intersection has exactly one real root, so the discriminant \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 0 \):
\[ (2 - k)^2 - 4(1)(9) = 0 \implies (2 - k)^2 - 36 = 0 \]
\[ (2 - k)^2 = 36 \implies 2 - k = \pm 6 \]
\[ 2 - k = 6 \implies k = -4, \quad 2 - k = -6 \implies k = 8 \]
Answer: \( k = -4 \) or \( k = 8 \).

body.en:
Problem (Medium): Consider the factored quartic polynomial \( f(x) = (x^2 - 1)(x^2 - 49) \). Find the constant term \( f(0) \).

Step-by-Step Solution: Evaluating at \( x = 0 \) gives \( f(0) = (-1)(-49) = 49 \).

body.en:
Problem (Hard): The polynomial identity \( (6x + 1)(x + 10) = 6x^2 + fx + 10 \) holds for all \( x \). Find the linear coefficient \( f \).

Step-by-Step Solution: Expanding the product gives \( f = 6\cdot 10 + 1 = 61 \).

body.en:
1. Extraneous Roots in Logarithmic & Radical Equations: On Cambridge IGCSE Additional Mathematics (0606), solving \(\log_2(x) + \log_2(x - 4) = 4\) or \(\sqrt{x + 4} = x - 1\) produces two quadratic roots, one of which makes the original log argument \(\le 0\) or the RHS of the square root negative. Failing to reject the extraneous root costs the final accuracy mark.

2. Confusing Removable Holes with Vertical Asymptotes: If \((x - 4)\) cancels from both numerator and denominator of \(R(x)\), then \(x = 4\) is a removable hole (point discontinuity), not a vertical asymptote.
body.ar: 1. الجذور الدخيلة في المعادلات اللوغاريتمية والجذرية: يجب دائماً التعويض بالجذور الناتجة في المعادلة الأصلية واستبعاد أي جذر يجعل ما داخل اللوغاريتم سالباً أو صفراً.

body.en: Fast Exam Check (Cambridge IGCSE Additional Mathematics (0606)): To verify an inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) in 5 seconds, pick a simple input \(x_0\), compute \(y_0 = f(x_0)\), and check that \(f^{-1}(y_0) = x_0\). Also verify that the graph of \(y = f^{-1}(x)\) reflects \(y = f(x)\) across \(y = x\).

question.en: [Practice 2 · Easy] A sector of a circle of radius \( r = 8 \text{ cm} \) has central angle \( \theta = 0.9 \text{ rad} \). What is the area of the sector?
